newsitem.title: USA: Arthur J. Gallagher sees $7 mln Q2 gains.
newsitem.headline: Arthur J. Gallagher sees $7 mln Q2 gains.

text.p: Arthur J. Gallagher & Co said Tuesday its subsidiary, AJG Financial Services Inc, has completed two restructuring agreements in the United Kingdom which will result in pre-tax gains totaling $7 million.
As a result of a restructuring and settlement within its U.K. benefit plan package, the company said it will report a one time pre-tax gain of about $5 million.

Gallagher also said its U.K. subsidiary, Arthur J. Gallagher (UK) Limited, participated in the restructuring of its current commercial lease arrangements and will report a one-time pre-tax gain of about $2 million.

The benefits restructuring brings the company's U.K. benefit packages more in line with the current concepts being offered in today's overseas benefit plans and was primarily the result of gains on investments recorded in the prior pension plan.
Both of these transactions will be included in the company's second quarter results which will be issued in mid-July.

Arthur J. Gallagher provides international insurance brokerage and risk management services. It has 153 offices in seven countries and does business in 72 additional countries through corresponding brokers.
